title: 第25章 萧曦月渡劫一碗鸡汁面第26章 林东方的本命乐器唢呐
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
林东方对那个小磨盘爱不释手。
以前在地球上的时候他喜欢用自己的小手磨做水磨汤圆。
破壁机什么的还是差了些意思。
把磨盘放在一边。
他把用鸡汁煮熟的鸡胸肉切块，蘑菇切丁，送进烤箱烤干水分。
烤干水分，必须把风阵打开。
这一下，五十只鸡熬出的鸡汁香味彻底藏不住了。
这是浓缩的香气，远远超过老汤的味道。
此时月亮已经缓缓升起。
“今天是月中十五，这月亮真圆啊。”
“有了烤箱，可以做月饼了。”
“正好还有桃花瓣，要不搞点桃花糖馅的水晶月饼？”
他在这对月考虑吃的，但是别人都对月修炼。
月中十五的月华最盛，是修炼太阴之力修士最爱的时候。
“轰！”
萧曦月的小院中忽然爆发出一阵冲天的光芒。
这道光芒圣洁，轻柔，虽然明亮却不炽烈。
林东方好奇的看向那边，那道光芒似乎沟通了天上的圆月和萧曦月的院落。
点点仙光骤然出现，似乎是随着月光由圆月中落下。
一股莫名的气机忽然勾动了天道。

“仙道元婴！”
数道目光瞬间从未知处看向瑶池圣地！
瑶池圣主第一时间显化而出，直接祭出瑶池的仙器，西皇镜笼罩了整个瑶池圣地。
“千年前，瑶池圣主结仙道元婴，千年登顶渡劫绝巅，难道这一世上苍还如此垂帘瑶池圣地么？”
远方，有人幽幽开口。
“道友若是观礼，大可显化真身，若是想暗中坏了曦月的道基，就别怪本尊出手狠辣！”
西皇镜震颤，此时，浩瀚无垠的南域所有生灵都感觉到了一股难言的压抑压在心头。
仙道气息让天外的星辰都在摇颤！
她一是怕有人暗中出手加害萧曦月，二是怕有人发现林东方的秘密！
此时这家伙好巧不巧的在院子中间烤鸡肉和蘑菇，那一烤箱的天地大道要是被那些渡劫老怪看到，肯定要疯！
一个圣地有一两个超级天骄很正常，但林东方这种可以批量制造超级天骄的‘悟道茶’就太可怕了。
不怕贼偷，就怕贼惦记。
瑶池圣主这一刻不再掩饰她霸绝天地的战力，恐怖的气势还在疯涨！
暗中的人顿时退去。
找谁的晦气也不能找这位的。
绝代天骄。
数百年走完了别人数千年的路，简直可怕到了极点。
“轰隆隆…”
九道太阴仙力从圆月中出现，落入萧曦月体内。
圣洁的仙力充盈在妙音峰上，道道仙音响起，各种瑞彩纷至沓来。

“这是妙音峰的仙音传承，不想这时候居然出现了…”
“时隔数万年终于再次出现了“”
content_en:
Lin Dongfang couldn't put it down on that little millstone.
When he was on Earth, he liked to use his little hand grinder to make glutinous rice balls.
The wall-breaking machine is still a bit uninteresting.
Set the millstone aside.
He cut chicken breasts cooked in chicken juice into cubes, diced mushrooms, and put them in the oven to dry out the moisture.
To dry out the moisture, the wind blast must be turned on.
At this time, the aroma of the chicken juice boiled by fifty chickens could no longer be hidden.
This is a concentrated aroma that far exceeds the taste of old soup.
At this time the moon has slowly risen.
"Today is the fifteenth day of the month, and the moon is so round."
"With the oven, we can make mooncakes."
"There just happen to be some peach blossom petals, how about some crystal mooncakes filled with peach blossom candy?"
He was thinking about what to eat on this pair of moons, but everyone else was practicing on this pair of moons.
The moonlight is at its strongest on the fifteenth day of the month, and it is the favorite time for monks who practice the power of the lunar calendar.
"Boom!"
Suddenly, a burst of light burst into the sky in Xiao Xiyue's courtyard.
This light is holy, gentle, bright but not blazing.
Lin Dongfang looked over there curiously. The light seemed to connect the full moon in the sky and Xiao Xiyue's courtyard.
Dots of fairy light suddenly appeared, as if falling from the full moon with the moonlight.
An inexplicable energy suddenly stirred up the Heavenly Dao.
"Immortal Nascent Soul!"
Several eyes instantly looked towards Yaochi Holy Land from an unknown place!
The Holy Lord of Yaochi appeared immediately and directly sacrificed the immortal weapon of Yaochi. The West Emperor Mirror enveloped the entire Yaochi Holy Land.
"Thousands of years ago, the Holy Lord of Yaochi married the Immortal Dao Nascent Soul and climbed to the top to overcome the tribulation for thousands of years. Is it possible that in this life, God will still be so blind to the Yaochi Holy Land?"
In the distance, someone spoke quietly.
"If fellow Taoists are watching the ceremony, they can manifest their true form. If they want to secretly destroy Xiyue's Taoist foundation, don't blame me for being ruthless!"
The West Emperor Mirror trembled, and at this time, all the creatures in the vast Southern Territory felt an unspeakable oppression in their hearts.
The immortal aura makes the stars in the sky tremble!
Firstly, she was afraid that someone would secretly harm Xiao Xiyue, and secondly, she was afraid that someone would discover Lin Dongfang's secret!
At this time, this guy happened to be roasting chicken and mushrooms in the middle of the yard. If those old tribulation monsters saw that oven, they would definitely go crazy!
It is normal for a holy land to have one or two super geniuses, but Lin Dongfang's 'enlightenment tea' that can mass-produce super geniuses is too scary.
Don't be afraid of thieves stealing, just be afraid of thieves missing you.
At this moment, the Holy Lord of Yaochi no longer conceals her overwhelming combat power, and her terrifying aura is still rising!
The man in the dark immediately retreated.
You can't blame anyone for your bad luck.
Unparalleled genius.
It takes hundreds of years to complete the journey that others have taken thousands of years to complete, which is simply terrifying to the extreme.
"Rumble..."
Nine rays of lunar power appeared from the full moon and fell into Xiao Xiyue's body.
The holy immortal power filled the Miaoyin Peak, the immortal sounds sounded, and all kinds of auspicious colors came one after another.
"This is the fairy music inheritance of Miaoyin Peak. I didn't expect it to appear at this time..."
"Finally reappeared after tens of thousands of years"
